claim: The snapshot's reference fields (field handles) add no per-boundary allocation either way.
why: src/store.jl:149 capture_stores copies each eltype buffer shallowly, so the handle's bulk data is shared (test/test_store.jl:272); probe [106]: handle_model capture allocates 4 objects/144 B, the same count as an Int-port twin (4 objects/128 B) | Against an all-Float64 twin, the handle model allocates 2 more objects and 64 B more per boundary (publish! 928 B vs 864 B). That cost comes from the handle's extra eltype block, which any non-Float64 eltype adds, and not from its references. The reading 'no allocation beyond the snapshot's own table copy' holds.
